hyperedges.label: storage.js Broken Return Values Breaking useNewDonationPanel Toggle
Extension Data Handling and Security Boundary
Webpack Entry Point Architecture (HTML + JS Pairs)

nodes.label: storage.js Missing Return Statements
nodes.rationale: getStorage/setStorage/removeStorage never return their promises, so storage.get(...) synchronously returns undefined; breaks the useNewDonationPanel feature toggle in GreatBuildingsService.js.

nodes.label: Inconsistent Dependency Pinning
nodes.rationale: @wikimedia/jquery.i18n is exact-pinned while everything else uses ^; prettier is invoked via npx instead of being a pinned devDependency.

nodes.label: No Source Maps in Production Build
nodes.rationale: Real user crash reports are undebuggable without source maps.
nodes.norm_label: no source maps in production build

nodes.label: options.html Accessibility/Heading Hierarchy Gap
nodes.rationale: No fieldset/legend grouping, jumps straight to h6 with no heading hierarchy (11 sections, zero h1-h5); also the only page with no data-i18n coverage.

nodes.label: Pervasive var Usage and Unhandled Promise Rejections
nodes.norm_label: pervasive var usage and unhandled promise rejections

nodes.label: pendingStartupMsg Not Flushed on Success Path
nodes.rationale: Only the catch fallback flushes pendingStartupMsg; a startup message queued during a normal first load can be silently dropped.
nodes.norm_label: pendingstartupmsg not flushed on success path

nodes.label: showOptions.set() Stale Named Exports Bug
nodes.rationale: set() mutates the internal items object but never updates the individually named exports, which stay frozen at defaults forever.

nodes.label: WebSocket-Expert Skip Rationale (False Positive Match)
nodes.rationale: WebSocket-expert was skipped because the only 'websocket' reference is a DevTools _resourceType filter check, not an actual WebSocket implementation.

nodes.label: MV3 Manifest Compliance and Restrictive CSP
nodes.rationale: Manifest is correctly MV3, action:{} present, CSP restricts script-src to 'self', no inline scripts/handlers, all icons correct, host_permissions scoped (no <all_urls>).
nodes.norm_label: mv3 manifest compliance and restrictive csp

nodes.label: No jQuery Event-Leak Patterns
nodes.rationale: .on()/.off() aren't used at all; event wiring is native addEventListener on nodes that get GC'd naturally via innerHTML replacement.

nodes.label: forEach Return Discarded (inactiveHTML)
nodes.rationale: return inside .forEach() is discarded so inactiveHTML() always returns ''; the INACTIVE badge never renders.

nodes.label: setMyGuildPermissions Undeclared Variable Bug
nodes.rationale: Writes to undeclared MyGuildPermissions instead of the real one in helper.js; dead/unused duplicate export, currently harmless because unreachable.

nodes.label: Latent XSS via Unescaped Player/Guild Names
nodes.rationale: Server-provided player/guild names are interpolated unescaped into innerHTML template literals; a malicious display name with
nodes.norm_label: latent xss via unescaped player/guild names

nodes.label: Undefined getKey() Call in postToDiscord
nodes.rationale: Currently unreachable but will crash the moment postToDiscord is wired up; only a commented-out getKey exists in helper.js.

nodes.label: Assignment-in-Condition Bug (clan_goods)
nodes.rationale: if ((x.name = 'clan_goods')) is an assignment not a comparison in 3 places; always truthy and corrupts the response object.

nodes.label: darkMode Assignment Instead of Comparison
nodes.rationale: darkMode == 'dark'; should be = ; dark-mode state never updates when the OS theme changes.

nodes.label: Duplicated If/Else Chains Needing Lookup Tables
nodes.norm_label: duplicated if/else chains needing lookup tables

nodes.label: Missing body Element in HTML Templates
nodes.rationale: Works today only because HtmlWebpackPlugin falls back to injecting scripts into head.
nodes.norm_label: missing body element in html templates

nodes.label: Google Fonts Loaded at Runtime from panel.html
nodes.rationale: Leaks a fetch to Google and breaks offline/hardened environments for a DevTools panel; should self-host.
nodes.norm_label: google fonts loaded at runtime from panel.html

nodes.label: webRequest onBeforeSendHeaders No-Op Bug
nodes.rationale: extraInfoSpec missing 'blocking' so returned requestHeaders are ignored by Chrome; also MV3 restricts blocking webRequest to force-installed/enterprise extensions since Chrome 121, so a Web Store extension cannot use it even if fixed. Recommended fix: declarativeNetRequest modifyHeaders rule.

nodes.label: Hardcoded Colors Bypassing SCSS Variables
nodes.rationale: Hardcoded colors throughout custom.scss bypass _variables.scss/Bootstrap tokens; ~44% of custom.scss (lines 397-680) is commented-out dead CSS.

nodes.label: Invalid CSS Properties/Values (fw: bold, float: center)
nodes.norm_label: invalid css properties/values (fw: bold, float: center)

nodes.label: Empty manifest name/version Filled at Build Time (Intentional)
nodes.rationale: manifest.json's empty name/version fields are intentional, filled in at build time by WebpackExtensionManifestPlugin from package.json, not a bug.
nodes.norm_label: empty manifest name/version filled at build time (intentional)

nodes.label: Unused Permission Surface (web_accessible_resources / externally_connectable)
nodes.rationale: Looks like leftover surface from an earlier content-script architecture; dead but widens attack surface unnecessarily.

nodes.label: $('body').i18n() Full-Document Rescans
nodes.rationale: Re-scans the entire document on nearly every network response (14+ call sites) instead of scoping to the just-injected container.

nodes.label: Undefined CSS Custom Properties in body Styles
nodes.norm_label: undefined css custom properties in body styles

nodes.label: Runtime Dependencies Correctly Placed (Not devDependencies)
nodes.rationale: jquery/bootstrap/dayjs etc. placed as dependencies not devDependencies is correct since they are bundled into the shipped extension.

nodes.label: FoE Info Branding (wordmark over landscape collage)
nodes.norm_label: foe info branding (wordmark over landscape collage)
